source._build_note: Top-level `make all` builds everything from the in-tree deps/ (jemalloc 5.3.0, lua 5.1, libvalkey, linenoise, hdr_histogram, fpconv, fast_float) — NO dependency download, fully offline-capable once the source tree is present. builder_image is ubuntu:24.04, the runtime's own distro (gcc 13, glibc 2.39): build-essential (gcc/g++/make/libc6-dev; g++ REQUIRED for USE_FAST_FLOAT=yes, a C++ leaf), pkg-config and libssl-dev are vendored as build debs for the offline make. BUILD_TLS=yes compiles TLS in-tree and needs only OpenSSL headers (libssl-dev) at build + libssl3t64 (libssl.so.3) at runtime. `make install PREFIX=/opt/valkey` lays down valkey-server/valkey-cli/valkey-benchmark and symlinks valkey-sentinel/valkey-check-rdb/valkey-check-aof to valkey-server. dep_bumps does NOT apply to C; the Grade-A CVE lever is the fresh base + the debvendor dist-upgrade of libssl3t64/libc6 (same as redis). NEVER run `make test*` — the deps/ gtest-parallel target does a network git clone (test-only, not in `all`).

binaries_from_source.name: valkey-server
binaries_from_source._note: The daemon. `valkey-server --version` -> `Valkey server v=9.1.0 sha=... malloc=jemalloc-5.3.0 bits=64 build=...`. Links libssl.so.3/libcrypto.so.3 (BUILD_TLS=yes -> runtime base ships libssl3t64, Ubuntu 24.04's libssl.so.3 package). valkey-check-rdb/valkey-check-aof/valkey-sentinel are install-time symlinks to this same binary.

binaries_from_source.name: valkey-cli
binaries_from_source._note: REQUIRED in the runtime image — it IS the health check, the seed driver, and the doc-probe client (Valkey has no HTTP; RESP over TCP 6379 only). `valkey-cli --version` -> `valkey-cli 9.1.0`.
